quarterly_data.quarter: Fujitsu press release: Fujitsu launches next-generation CPU FUJITSU-MONAKA (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fujitsu will begin global sales of its next-generation CPU FUJITSU-MONAKA starting November 2026, including sales of the processor as a standalone product to cloud and data center operators and server vendors. The made-in-Japan Fujitsu MONAKA Server (2U with two CPUs, 1U with one or two CPUs) will be sold from November 2026 to data center operators, enterprises, academic / HPC and defense customers in Japan and Europe; servers are manufactured at Fujitsu's Kasashima Plant.

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujitsu press release: Fujitsu launches next-generation CPU FUJITSU-MONAKA (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FUJITSU-MONAKA uses a 3D-stacked architecture with a 2nm process for the cores and a 5nm process for the cache and I/O sections, a maximum operating frequency of 3.8GHz and memory transfer speed of 8800MT/s, hardware acceleration for matrix operations, SVE2 vector operations and confidential computing. Fujitsu claims twice the AI inference throughput of other CPUs, halving the servers and power needed for equivalent loads; the 1U server runs air-cooled up to 40 degrees Celsius ambient or water-cooled up to 45 degrees Celsius and, per Fujitsu, cuts server cooling power by up to 80%.
